mapper.sql: id, assessment_id, indicator_id, actual_value, target_value, score, weight, weighted_score, data_source, calculation_formula, remarks, create_time, create_by
mapper.select: SELECT ai.indicator_id, ai.indicator_name, ai.indicator_code, ai.weight, ai.unit, ROUND(AVG(ad.score), 2) as averageScore, ROUND(MAX(ad.score), 2) as maxScore, ROUND(MIN(ad.score), 2) as minScore, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ad.actual_value >= ad.target_value THEN 100 ELSE 0 END), 2) as achievementRate, COUNT(*) as totalCount FROM assessment_detail ad LEFT JOIN assessment_indicator ai ON ad.indicator_id = ai.id LEFT JOIN project_assessment pa ON ad.assessment_id = pa.id WHERE pa.assessment_period = #{assessmentPeriod} AND pa.assessment_status >= 2 GROUP BY ai.indicator_id, ai.indicator_name, ai.indicator_code, ai.weight, ai.unit ORDER BY ai.sort_order ASC, ai.id ASC
